standard_prerequisites.name: Smale ordering theorem

standard_prerequisites.name: Shadowing lemma
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Faure-Hasselblatt, Th. 5.3.3, cited by the author

core_obligations: Deliver the author's proposition: under Axiom A and strong transversality the four conormal subsets of S*M are compact and invariant under the lifted flow.
proof_roadmap: Step one closes the case of a single basic set by shadowing and continuity.
Step two constructs inductively exit times and new accumulation points on higher basic sets.
Step three analyzes the cotangent phase at each exit with the big-lemma corollary; step four chains the implications to a contradiction with the invariance.
